sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_order_item oi INNER JOIN sku_mapping sm ON oi.platform_item_id = sm.platform_item_id INNER JOIN sku s ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND s.category_id = #{qo.categoryId})

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount_rub), 0) FROM erp_order o WHERE DATE(o.platform_created_at_moscow) BETWEEN #{qo.startDate} AND #{qo.endDate} AND o.erp_status != 'CANCELED'

SELECT o.platform, COALESCE(o.fulfillment_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS fulfillmentType, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount_rub), 0) AS totalAmount FROM erp_order o WHERE DATE(o.platform_created_at_moscow) BETWEEN #{qo.startDate} AND #{qo.endDate} AND o.erp_status != 'CANCELED'
GROUP BY o.platform, o.fulfillment_type ORDER BY o.platform, o.fulfillment_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.platform_created_at_moscow, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') AS timePoint, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount_rub), 0) AS totalSales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.erp_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN o.total_amount_rub ELSE 0 END), 0) AS effectiveSales FROM erp_order o WHERE DATE(o.platform_created_at_moscow) BETWEEN #{qo.startDate} AND #{qo.endDate} AND o.erp_status != 'CANCELED'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.platform_created_at_moscow, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') ORDER BY timePoint

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.platform_created_at_moscow, '%Y-%m-%d') AS timePoint, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount_rub), 0) AS totalSales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.erp_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN o.total_amount_rub ELSE 0 END), 0) AS effectiveSales FROM erp_order o WHERE DATE(o.platform_created_at_moscow) BETWEEN #{qo.startDate} AND #{qo.endDate} AND o.erp_status != 'CANCELED'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.platform_created_at_moscow, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY timePoint

SELECT o.erp_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount_rub), 0) AS totalAmount FROM erp_order o WHERE DATE(o.platform_created_at_moscow) BETWEEN #{qo.startDate} AND #{qo.endDate}
GROUP BY o.erp_status ORDER BY o.erp_status

SELECT COALESCE(sm.sku_code, oi.platform_item_id) AS article, MAX(CASE WHEN sm.sku_code IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS isMapped, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount_rub), 0) AS totalAmount FROM erp_order o INNER JOIN erp_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN sku_mapping sm ON oi.platform_item_id = sm.platform_item_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code WHERE DATE(o.platform_created_at_moscow) BETWEEN #{qo.startDate} AND #{qo.endDate} AND oi.platform_item_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.platform_item_id != '' AND o.erp_status != 'CANCELED'
GROUP BY COALESCE(sm.sku_code, oi.platform_item_id) ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(sm.sku_code, oi.platform_item_id) AS sku, MAX(CASE WHEN sm.sku_code IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS isMapped, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount_rub), 0) / 100 AS amount, MAX(s.id) AS skuId, MAX(s.chinese_name) AS skuNameCn, MAX(s.category_id) AS categoryId, MAX(c.name) AS categoryName FROM erp_order o INNER JOIN erp_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN sku_mapping sm ON oi.platform_item_id = sm.platform_item_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code LEFT JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.id WHERE DATE(o.platform_created_at_moscow) BETWEEN #{qo.startDate} AND #{qo.endDate} AND oi.platform_item_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.platform_item_id != '' AND o.erp_status != 'CANCELED'
GROUP BY COALESCE(sm.sku_code, oi.platform_item_id)
ORDER BY quantity ASC
ORDER BY quantity DESC
ORDER BY amount ASC
ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(sm.sku_code, oi.platform_item_id) AS sku, MAX(CASE WHEN sm.sku_code IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS isMapped, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.item_amount_rub), 0) / 100 AS amount, MAX(s.id) AS skuId, MAX(s.chinese_name) AS skuNameCn, MAX(s.category_id) AS categoryId, MAX(c.name) AS categoryName FROM erp_order o INNER JOIN erp_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN sku_mapping sm ON oi.platform_item_id = sm.platform_item_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code LEFT JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.id WHERE DATE(o.platform_created_at_moscow) BETWEEN #{qo.startDate} AND #{qo.endDate} AND oi.platform_item_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.platform_item_id != '' AND o.erp_status != 'CANCELED'
GROUP BY COALESCE(sm.sku_code, oi.platform_item_id)
ORDER BY quantity ASC
